issues.description: The problem statement requires a static method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal) in SealSaloon, but the provided codebase uses a different identifier (computeMealCost) in SealSaloon, while some Main examples reference calculateTotalPrice. This identifier mismatch across problem documentation, template, and solution (calculateTotalPrice vs computeMealCost) can confuse students about the correct method name to implement and may cause referencing code to be inconsistent.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the identifier across all artifacts. Rename computeMealCost to calculateTotalPrice in SealSaloon (and keep it static) and update any references in Main or templates accordingly; alternatively, update the problem statement and UML to use computeMealCost consistently. Ensure the method name in the specification, templates, and solution match so students know which method to implement.
